chunks: Muḥammad ibn Bajīl, the brother of ʿAlī ibn Bajīl, narrated, saying:
I saw Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام praying, and a man passed by him while he was between the two prostrations. So Abū ʿAbdillāh threw a small stone at him, and the man came toward him.

key_terms.بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ: in the interval between the two prostrations of salat (prayer)
key_terms.بِحَصَاةٍ: with a small stone or pebble
key_terms.فَأَقْبَلَ: then he came forward or approached

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام do when someone passed by him during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an observed incident involving Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام during salat (prayer). It depicts a practical action taken while he was between the two prostrations, indicating interaction with a passerby during the prayer.
